activity.role: Philosopher and pseudonymous author of Either/Or, first published in Copenhagen
activity.notes: Either/Or (Enten–Eller) was published in Copenhagen in 1843 under the editorial pseudonym Victor Eremita. The one-year point is the book's publication, not a continuous office or the entire philosophical career. The Danish polity is location affiliation only, not an office. Authorial pseudonyms are not distinct historical Persons.
